name: 55 W drive
description: A drive, a turn and a boomerang on the 55 W drive Override allows (R11): four 11 W motors and two 5.5 W motors, with two tracking wheels. In the simulator the drive ends 0.03 in off in 1.63 s, the turn 0.5° off in 0.47 s, and the boomerang 0.10 in and 0.3° off in 3.39 s. On the six-motor 66 W drive the same boomerang ends 0.34 in off in 3.68 s; switch Drivetrain and run again to compare. 6.4 s.

steps.note: curve to the right, arriving facing forward
